title: Comprehensive Bible Explorer
facts: The Bible Explorer contains the complete 66-book canon of the Holy Bible.
It encompasses both the Old Testament (39 books) and the New Testament (27 books).
Users can read complete chapters and individual verses with distraction-free layout.
High-speed full-text search indexing allows finding any word, topic, or scripture passage across the entire Bible.
Easy navigation allows flipping seamlessly between books, testaments, and chapters.
Responsive text sizing controls let readers adjust typography comfortably for mobile, tablet, or desktop reading.
The Bible Explorer is available full-screen for immersive reading.
rules: Do not claim a specific translation is available unless explicitly indicated in Zionaviel's current Bible reader data.
